column1: # Peak-price windows: the only owner of when a provider charges more.
# bin/jg-peak-lib.sh reads this file in place from the code root; nothing about
# a window is coded in a script. A home overrides it with config/peak-windows.tsv.
# Tab-separated columns:
#   provider    the route's provider prefix; an -cloud suffix is ignored, so
#               ollama-cloud routes match the ollama row
#   model glob  matched against the whole route and against its model part
#   days        UTC ISO weekdays that peak: *, N, N-M, or a comma-separated list
#   hours       UTC peak windows HH:MM-HH:MM, end-exclusive, comma-separated,
#               never crossing UTC midnight
#   source      where the window was read
#   checked     the UTC date that source was read
#   status      confirmed gates dispatch; unconfirmed is recorded evidence that
#               decides nothing, so a guess never blocks work
# Ollama charges double on DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and V4 Pro inside its weekday
# peak window and the list price outside it, all weekend included.
# DeepSeek's own API peaks in two earlier weekday windows; its off-peak rate is
# half price everywhere else, weekends and Chinese public holidays in full.
provider
ollama
deepseek
openrouter
